members.name: vwap_rsi_volume_confluence_v1
members.thesis: Individual signals (VWAP deviation, RSI extreme, volume surge) are noisy alone. But when all three fire simultaneously — price > 1.5 SD below VWAP AND RSI(7) < 20 AND volume > 3x average — the probability of mean reversion is dramatically higher. filters: no trades first 15 min or last 15 min
weaknesses: Extremely rare signal — all three conditions firing simultaneously may happen 1-2 times per week across all 30 stocks
During genuine panic selloffs, all three fire but the stock keeps falling — stop loss is essential
Confluence requirement means you miss many trades where 2 of 3 conditions hold (and those might also be profitable)

members.exit_target: close crosses vwap (VWAP_Distance crosses zero from entry side)
members.exit_stop: 0.4% from entry price (40 bps hard stop)
filters: India VIX < 25; if VIX > 20, halve position size
No new entries after 15:00 IST; no entries before 09:20 IST
Skip if stock 5-min volume < 50% of 20-day average for that 5-min bucket
NIFTY 50 not down > 1.5% from previous close (avoid crash days)
Bid-ask spread < 5 bps at time of entry
weaknesses: Triple confirmation is restrictive — may generate only 1-2 signals per day across entire universe, leading to significant opportunity cost
RSI(14) on 1-min bars is noisy and can whipsaw rapidly; 14-bar lookback on 1-min data captures only 14 minutes of price action
VWAP mean-reversion breaks down on strong trend days (e.g., post-RBI policy, budget days) where price can stay 100+ bps from VWAP for hours
